title: Fake News
text:
Many people read news on social media every day. Social media is fast, but not all news is true. Some stories are fake news. Fake news is made to look real, but the facts are wrong.

Sometimes people share a fake story because they do not check it first. Before you share, read the story again and look at the website. If the facts are not clear, do not share it.

questions.text: How often do many people read news on social media?
Why do people share a fake story, according to the second paragraph?
options: They do not check it first
They read it in a book

questions.text: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: News on social media can be false, so check it before you share
Social media is always bad for people
Fake news is always easy to see

questions.text: What can you infer about fake news from the first paragraph?
options: It can look real even though it is not true
It is always easy to find
It is only made by famous people
It is always shared by teachers

vocabulary.definition: to send a story or post to other people
to look carefully to see if something is correct

paragraph_translations: Birçok insan her gün sosyal medyada haber okur. Sosyal medya hızlıdır, ama her haber doğru değildir. Bazı haberler sahte haberlerdir. Sahte haberler gerçekmiş gibi görünecek şekilde yapılır, ama gerçekler yanlıştır.
Bazen insanlar bir sahte hikayeyi önce kontrol etmedikleri için paylaşırlar. Paylaşmadan önce hikayeyi tekrar okuyun ve web sitesine bakın. Gerçekler açık değilse, paylaşmayın.
